core_obligations: Show that the finite level global sections M_n are pseudo-coherent over D(A_n) with base change compatible formation, so the transition maps are isomorphisms (proof lines 8476-8486).
Use the pseudo-coherence of derived limits and the commutation of the exact functor RGamma(X, -) with derived limits to identify RGamma(X, E otimes^L K) with Rlim M_n (proof lines 8488-8500).
proof_roadmap: Pseudo-coherence and base change of the finite level sections (proof lines 8476-8486).
The derived limit and the identification (proof lines 8488-8500).
difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-existence-derived with K as in Lemma labelled lemma-compute-what-it-should-be-derived, the lemma asserts for every perfect E of D(O_X) that M = RGamma(X, K otimes^L E) is pseudo-coherent over D(A) with a canonical isomorphism RGamma(X_n, K_n otimes^L E|_{X_n}) = M otimes_A^L A_n (statement lines 8461-8474). The proof writes E_n = E|_{X_n} and M_n = RGamma(X_n, K_n otimes^L E|_{X_n}), and uses Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-flat-proper-pseudo-coherent-direct-image-general to see that each M_n is pseudo-coherent over D(A_n) with base change compatible formation, so the transition maps M_n otimes^L A_{n-1} -> M_{n-1} are isomorphisms (proof lines 8476-8486). More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-Rlim-pseudo-coherent-gives-pseudo-coherent then makes Rlim M_n pseudo-coherent and recovers its base changes, and since RGamma(X, -) is exact and commutes with products hence with derived limits, RGamma(X, E otimes^L K) = Rlim RGamma(X, E otimes^L K_n) = Rlim M_n, which is the desired identification (proof lines 8488-8500). Recognising that the system of pseudo-coherent complexes is well behaved enough for its derived limit to be pseudo-coherent, and identifying that limit with the global sections of the twist, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
